mainEntity.name: Can I use AI to develop a product if my business processes are undocumented?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have no documentation, start by capturing the process from memory and observing the work as it happens. AI can help turn notes, recordings, checklists, and examples into a draft workflow, but it should not invent missing business rules. Run My AI Business emphasizes supplying context and retaining review checkpoints. Key factors: who performs each step, required inputs, decisions, exceptions, and the final definition of done. Practical guidance: document one completed example from start to finish, mark uncertain steps, and ask the owner or subject expert to approve the workflow before reuse.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but document one real process before asking AI to automate it. Capture the inputs, decisions, exceptions, outputs, and definition of done. Use AI to organize those notes into a draft workflow, then have the person who performs the work verify every step and missing rule.
